title: Cascade layers and @layer
learningObjectives: Explain cascade layers and @layer and organise styles for maintainability.

understand.concept: Cascade layers organise author styles into named layers with a defined precedence order. @layer can declare a layer order and group rules. Layer precedence is considered before specificity within the relevant cascade origin and importance level; important declarations have reversed layer precedence.
understand.whyItMatters: Layers can reduce specificity escalation by making ownership and precedence explicit. Establish the layer order centrally and avoid creating accidental unlayered overrides that outrank normal layered author styles.
understand.analogy: Cascade layers are like labelled shelves with an agreed priority order; the browser checks the shelf order before comparing selector detail within the relevant cascade step.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; CSS cascade, inheritance, and conditional rules follow the formal cascade and at-rule processing model.

explain.narrative: The declared layer order controls normal declaration precedence among these author layers. Selector specificity is not the first comparison between layers.

examples.explanation: The declared layer order controls normal declaration precedence among these author layers. Selector specificity is not the first comparison between layers.
examples.expectedOutput: A rendered example showing the naming, token, theme, or cascade organisation described.

practise.guidedTask: Create reset, base, and component layers. Put conflicting declarations in different layers and verify which value wins.
practise.independentTask: Refactor a small stylesheet using a consistent naming or organisation strategy. Verify the computed results and document the intended rule boundaries.
hints: Establish shared token and layer conventions centrally.
Keep baseline styles usable without enhancements.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Cascade layers and @layer</title></head><body>
<style>@layer reset,base,components,utilities;@layer base{.button{color:#17324d;background:#eef2f5}}@layer components{.button{color:#245b48}}@layer utilities{.text-dark{color:#111}}</style><button class='button'>Layered button</button>
</body></html>
